Rashi on Eruvin 38b:13:1.hebrew: מי סברת סוף היום - של ע"ש קונה עירוב, דהוי יו"ט מכין לשבת:
Rashi on Eruvin 38b:13:1.english: Do you think the end of the day - of Shabbat eve acquires the eiruv, so that it would be a Festival preparing for Shabbat?

Rashi on Eruvin 38b:14:1.hebrew: יערבו בלגין - לגין טבול יום, דתנן לעיל בפירקין (עירובין דף לו.): שמילאהו מן החבית של טבל, ואמר: "הרי זה תרומת מעשר לכשתחשך" — דבריו קיימין; ואם אמר: "עירבו לי בה" — לא אמר כלום. אלמא, סוף היום קונה עירוב, ואכתי טבל הוא:
Rashi on Eruvin 38b:14:1.english: Let them establish an eiruv with a flask - [The case of] a flask that was immersed that day [tevul yom], as we learned earlier in our chapter (Eruvin 36a): [Where] one filled it from a barrel of tevel and said, “Let this be terumat ma’aser when it gets dark,” his words stand; but if he said, “Establish an eiruv for me with it,” he has said nothing. Evidently, the end of the day acquires the eiruv, and it is still tevel [at that time].

Rashi on Eruvin 38b:16:1.hebrew: ה"ג אלא הא דתנן ר' אליעזר כו' - הא בעינן סעודה הראויה מבעוד יום, וליכא:
Rashi on Eruvin 38b:16:1.english: This is the reading: “Rather, that which we learned: Rabbi Eliezer, etc.” - “Don’t we require a meal that is fit while it is still day, and there is none?”

Rashi on Eruvin 38b:16:2.hebrew: מערב אדם שני עירובין - וקס"ד: זה לסוף אלפים למזרח, וזה לסוף אלפים למערב. וכי קנה לו יום ראשון למזרח, אי הוה בעי למיזל למערב העיר פסיעה אחת — לא מצי אזיל, דממקום עירובו יש לו אלפים אמה לכל רוח, והרי מעירובו ועד עירו הוי אלפים; וכל עירו מיהא מצי אזיל, דכולה לדידיה — כיון דלן בה — כד' אמות דמיא ליה, אבל טפי לא מצי אזיל ליה. והיכי קני ליה עירוב דבמערב בבין השמשות? הא בעינן סעודה הראויה מבעוד יום, והא אי הוה בעי למיזל ומיכליה מבעוד יום — לא מצי אזיל:
Rashi on Eruvin 38b:16:2.english: A person may establish two eiruvin - And it entered [the Gemara's] mind [that this means]: this [eiruv is placed] at the end of two thousand [cubits] to the east, and that [eiruv is placed] at the end of two thousand [cubits] to the west. And when [the eiruv] acquired [residence] for him on the first day to the east, if he wanted to walk even one step to the west of the city, he could not go, for from the location of his eiruv he has two thousand cubits in every direction, and behold, from his eiruv to his city is two thousand [cubits]; and at least throughout his entire city he can walk, since for him the whole [city] — since he lodges in it — is considered like four cubits, but beyond that he cannot go. And how does the eiruv in the west acquire [residence] for him at twilight? Behold, we require a meal that is fit [to be eaten] while it is still day, and behold, if he wanted to go and eat it while it was still day, he could not go!

Rashi on Eruvin 38b:17:1.english: At the end of two thousand [cubits] - For then he has nothing further toward the opposite side on the first day.

Rashi on Eruvin 38b:17:2.hebrew: לא דמנח ליה בסוף אלף כו' - דלא הוה צריך למיזל, לא בראשון ולא בשני, אלא שלשה אלפים, ונתן עירובו בסוף אלף לכל צד. הילכך, ביום ראשון, אע"פ שקנה עירובו למזרח, יכול לילך אצל עירובו במערב, דהא ממקום עירובו שבמזרח עד עירוב שבמערב אלפים הוא דהוו:
Rashi on Eruvin 38b:17:2.english: No, that he placed it at the end of one thousand, etc. - For he did not need to walk, neither on the first [day] nor on the second, more than three thousand [cubits], and he placed his eiruv at the end of one thousand [cubits] in each direction. Therefore, on the first day, even though his eiruv acquired [residence for him] to the east, he can walk to his eiruv in the west, as from the location of his eiruv in the east to the eiruv in the west is [only] two thousand [cubits].

Rashi on Eruvin 38b:18:1.hebrew: עירב בפת בראשון מערב בפת בשני - לקמן מפרש: באותו פת:
Rashi on Eruvin 38b:18:1.english: [If] he established an eiruv with bread on the first [day], he may establish an eiruv with bread on the second [day] - [The Gemara] explains below: With that same bread.

Rashi on Eruvin 38b:18:2.hebrew: והא קא מכין - כשמערב ברגליו בשני, מיו"ט לשבת. בשלמא מערב בשני בפת — תרצת דתחילת היום קונה עירוב, ועירוב דפת שתיקה, ממילא קני; אלא עירב ברגליו — ס"ד דבעי למימר: "שביתתי במקומי", ולא מצי לכוין תחילת היום, ובעי למימר מבעוד יום, ואישתכח דמכין באמירתו מיו"ט לשבת:
Rashi on Eruvin 38b:18:2.english: But isn’t he preparing - [This difficulty applies] when he establishes an eiruv with his feet on the second [day], from a Festival to Shabbat. Granted, [if] he establishes an eiruv on the second [day] with bread, you can answer that the onset of the day acquires the eiruv, and an eiruv with bread [is accomplished in] silence — it takes effect on its own; but [if] he established an eiruv with his feet, it enters one’s mind [to think] that he needs to say: “My Sabbath residence is in my place,” and he cannot pinpoint the onset of the day, so he must say [it] while it is still day, and it turns out that he is preparing through his statement from a Festival to Shabbat.

Rashi on Eruvin 38b:1:1.hebrew: הרי זה חמר גמל - דלמא חדא קדושה היא, וקנה עירוב לשני ימים, והפסיד אלפים שכנגד עירובו; וכאן לא קנה כלום, אלא אלפים שהיו לו בלא עירוב — ודלמא ב' קדושות הן, ולא קנה עירובו אלא ליום אחד, ודינו להיות בשני כבני עירו, ואין לו כאן אלא אלפים. וממה נפשך, בהנך אלפים אמה משתרי:
Rashi on Eruvin 38b:1:1.english: This person is a donkey driver and a camel driver - Perhaps it is one sanctity, and the eiruv acquired [his Shabbat residence] for two days, and he forfeited the two thousand [cubits] opposite his eiruv; and here [in the direction of his eiruv], he acquired nothing [further] other than the two thousand [cubits] that he had without an eiruv, [for] perhaps they are two sanctities and his eiruv acquired [his residence] for only one day, and his status on the second [day] is to be like the people of his town, and he has here only two thousand [cubits]. And whichever way you look at it, in those two thousand cubits he is permitted.

Rashi on Eruvin 38b:20:1.hebrew: רבי יוחנן בן נורי - לקמן במי שהוציאוהו קאמר דישן קונה שביתתו, ואף על גב דהוי כחפצי הפקר בעלמא, שאין אדם מקנה להם שביתה:
Rashi on Eruvin 38b:20:1.english: Rabbi Yoḥanan ben Nuri - Later, in [the chapter entitled] Mi Shehotzi’uhu, he says that a sleeping person acquires his Shabbat residence, even though he is merely like ownerless objects, for which no person establishes a Shabbat residence.

Rashi on Eruvin 38b:21:1.english: With regard to [one who is] awake - This is our reading.

Rashi on Eruvin 38b:22:1.hebrew: אי הוה שמיע ליה למר - לרבה, דמתרץ ואזיל כל הנך תירוצי, וקאמר דמשום דלא אמר מידי שרי, ואף על גב דאזל התם מבעוד יום:
Rashi on Eruvin 38b:22:1.english: If the Master had heard - [This refers] to Rabba, who went along offering all those resolutions and saying that because he did not say anything it is permitted, even though he went there while it was still day.

Rashi on Eruvin 38b:22:2.english: A person may not walk - On Shabbat.

Rashi on Eruvin 38b:22:3.english: To determine what it requires - [To be done] after Shabbat.

Rashi on Eruvin 38b:2:1.hebrew: אין מערב ברגליו בשני - א"צ לערב, דודאי קדושה אחת נינהו, וכחדא יומא אריכא הוי:
Rashi on Eruvin 38b:2:1.english: He does not establish an eiruv with his feet on the second [day] - He does not need to establish an eiruv, for they are certainly one sanctity, and it is like one long day.

Rashi on Eruvin 38b:3:1.hebrew: חד מינייהו ר' אלעזר - כל רבי אלעזר סתם בתלמוד שהוא תנא, רבי אלעזר בן שמוע הוא:
Rashi on Eruvin 38b:3:1.english: One of them is Rabbi Elazar - Any [mention of] Rabbi Elazar without qualification in the Talmud who is a Tanna is Rabbi Elazar ben Shamua.

Rashi on Eruvin 38b:3:2.hebrew: סתימתאה - קרי כל מי שראה רבי דבריו במקומות הרבה, ושנאן במשנה סתם:
Rashi on Eruvin 38b:3:2.english: Setimta’ah - [He] calls [by this title] anyone whose words Rebbi approved of in many places and taught them in the Mishnah anonymously.

Rashi on Eruvin 38b:4:1.english: We heard the opposite from them - Above.

Rashi on Eruvin 38b:5:1.hebrew: וכן א"ר שמעון - נאכל עירובו בראשון, אין יוצא עליו בשני:
Rashi on Eruvin 38b:5:1.english: And so Rabbi Shimon said - If his eruv was eaten on the first [day], he does not go out based on it on the second [day]:

Rashi on Eruvin 38b:6:1.english: And let [Rav] also count Rabbi - For we heard from him explicitly above.

Rashi on Eruvin 38b:6:2.hebrew: תני לה ולא סבר לה - ולדברי ר' אליעזר קאמר:
Rashi on Eruvin 38b:6:2.english: He taught it and did not hold it - And he stated [it] according to the words of Rabbi Eliezer.

Rashi on Eruvin 38b:7:1.hebrew: רבנן נמי - הנך רבן שמעון ור' ישמעאל — נהי דקתני "וכן", דלמא תנו ולא סברי לה:
Rashi on Eruvin 38b:7:1.english: The Rabbis also - Those [Sages], Rabban Shimon [ben Gamliel] and Rabbi Yishmael — granted that [the baraita] teaches "and so too," perhaps they taught [it] but do not hold [in accordance with] it?

Rashi on Eruvin 38b:7:2.hebrew: רב גמרא גמיר לה - מרביה, דהנך ארבעה זקנים סבירא להו כר"א, אבל רבי תני ולא סבר לה:
Rashi on Eruvin 38b:7:2.english: Rav learned [it as a] tradition - From his teacher, that these four Elders hold in accordance with Rabbi Eliezer, but Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi] taught [it] and did not hold [in accordance with] it.

Tosafot on Eruvin 38b:10:1.hebrew: אמר רבה משום הכנה דתניא - ר"ת מחק מספרו "דתניא", משום דאמר בריש ביצה (דף ב:): "רבה לטעמיה, דאמר רבה: והיה ביום הששי והכינו"; ואי ברייתא היא, מאי קאמר "לטעמיה"? ואין זו קושיא, דנקט "לטעמיה" משום דרבה הביא הברייתא תחילה לבית המדרש. ואין להקשות מן הברייתא לרבי יוחנן, דלית ליה הכנה בפ"ק דביצה (דף ד.) — דילמא לא מיתני בי רבי חייא ורבי אושעיא. ועוד, דאיכא פלוגתא דתנאי בפ"ק דביצה (דף ג.). ורש"י פירש בביצה: דרבה לטעמיה — דאמר אליביה באלו עוברין (פסחים מז:) דמוקצה דאורייתא מהאי קרא; ולא נהירא, ועוד דמשמע התם דהדר ביה:
Tosafot on Eruvin 38b:10:1.english: Rabba said: Because of preparation, as it is taught in a baraita - Rabbeinu Tam deleted "as it is taught in a baraita" from his text, because it says at the beginning of Beitzah (2b): "Rabba [is consistent] with his own reasoning, as Rabba said: 'And it shall come to pass on the sixth day that they shall prepare...'"; and if it is a baraita, why does it say "with his own reasoning"? Yet this is no difficulty, for [the Gemara] stated "with his own reasoning" because Rabba was the first to bring the baraita to the study hall. And one should not raise an objection from the baraita against Rabbi Yochanan, who does not hold of [the prohibition of] preparation in the first chapter of Beitzah (4a) — perhaps it was not taught in the academy of Rabbi Chiyya and Rabbi Oshaya. And furthermore, there is a dispute among Tannaim in the first chapter of Beitzah (3a). And Rashi explained in Beitzah that "Rabba [is consistent] with his own reasoning" [refers to that] which was said according to his opinion in [the chapter] Elu Overin (Pesachim 47b), that muktzeh is [prohibited] by Torah law based on this verse; but this is not satisfactory, and furthermore it implies there that he retracted [it].

Tosafot on Eruvin 38b:11:1.hebrew: ואין יו"ט מכין לשבת - דקרא משמע ביום הששי שהיה יורד המן. ואמר במדרש (מכילתא פרשת בשלח) דדרשינן: שלא ירד מן לישראל בשבתות וימים טובים. ויש מדרשים חלוקים, דדרשי': "ויברך ויקדש" — ברכו במן וקדשו במן; ובאתה קדשת: "וברכתו מכל הימים וקדשתו מכל הזמנים" — משמע דירד מן ביו"ט. ולפי זה צ"ל דהששי משמע המבורר, דהיינו חול, כמו הירך המיומנת שבירך (חולין דף צא.):
Tosafot on Eruvin 38b:11:1.english: And a Festival does not prepare for Shabbat - For the verse implies [that preparation occurs] on the sixth day, on which the manna would fall. And it states in the Midrash (Mekhilta, Parashat Beshallach) that we expound that manna did not fall for Israel on Shabbatot and Festivals. But there are midrashim that differ, for we expound: “And He blessed [the seventh day] and sanctified it” — He blessed it with the manna, and sanctified it through the manna; and in [the prayer of] Ata Kidashta [we recite]: “And You blessed it above all days, and sanctified it above all seasons,” which implies that manna did fall on a Festival. And according to this, one must say that “the sixth” implies the distinct [day], namely a weekday, just like “the thigh” [means] the prominent thigh among the thighs (Chullin 91a).

Tosafot on Eruvin 38b:16:1.hebrew: והא בעינן סעודה - וא"ת: והא ראויה היא לאותן שבתחומו, כמו שמערבין לישראל בתרומה כיון שראויה לכהנים? וי"ל: דכמו שצריך בלילה — דהיינו שעת קניית העירוב — שיהא הוא ועירובו תוך התחום, דאם נתגלגל העירוב חוץ לתחום לא הוי עירוב, ה"נ צריך שתהא תוך תחומו מבעוד יום. והא דקאמר: "והא בעינן סעודה הראויה מבעוד יום וליכא" — תימה, דמשמע דניחא ליה אי לא בעינן סעודה הראויה מבעוד יום, ואע"ג דסבר סוף היום קונה עירוב. ואמאי? כיון דס"ד דמנח אלפים לכאן ואלפים לכאן, היכי קנייה ליה סוף היום עירוב ושביתתו? הא עדיין בסוף היום ד' אלפים רחוק מעירובו:
Tosafot on Eruvin 38b:16:1.english: "Don't we require a meal" - And if you say: But isn't it fit for those who are within its boundary, just as we may establish an eiruv for an Israelite with terumah since it is fit for kohanim? And one can answer: Just as at night—that is, the time of acquiring the eiruv—it is necessary that he and his eiruv be within the boundary (for if the eiruv rolled outside the boundary, it is not an eiruv), so too it must be within his boundary while it is still day. And that which [the Gemara] says: "Don't we require a meal that is fit while it is still day, and there is none?" — [this is] puzzling, for it implies that it would be acceptable to him if we did not require a meal that is fit while it is still day, even though he maintains that the end of the day acquires the eiruv. But why? Since we assume that he placed [one eiruv] two thousand [cubits] in this direction and [one eiruv] two thousand [cubits] in that direction, how could the end of the day acquire for him the eiruv and his resting place? Behold, at the end of the day he is still four thousand [cubits] away from his eiruv!

Tosafot on Eruvin 38b:18:1.hebrew: הא קא מכין מיו"ט לשבת - וא"ת: אמאי לא פריך לרב יהודה גופיה ממלתיה דנפשיה, דע"כ אית ליה הכנה מדקאמר "אין מערבין תחילה בפת", והא קאמר "עירב ברגליו ביום ראשון מערב ברגליו ביום שני"? וי"ל, דהא דקאמר "מערב ברגליו ביום שני" — ברייתא דלעיל קתני לה, דפליגי בה רבי יהודה ורשב"ג. והא דקא מייתי מלתיה דרב יהודה — לפי שלא היתה ידוע להם. תדע, דלקמן קאמר אמלתא דרב יהודה: "אמר שמואל: ובאותו הפת"; והיכי מפרש שמואל מלתיה דרב יהודה, שהיה תלמידו? אלא ודאי רב יהודה ברייתא קתני:
Tosafot on Eruvin 38b:18:1.english: "Isn’t he preparing from a Festival to Shabbat" - And if you say: Why does [the Gemara] not object to Rav Yehuda himself from his own statement, for perforce he holds [that there is a prohibition against] preparation, since he says, "One may not establish an eiruv initially with bread," yet he says, "If one established an eiruv with his feet on the first day, he may establish an eiruv with his feet on the second day"? And one can say: That which he says, "He may establish an eiruv with his feet on the second day" — a baraita taught above teaches this, regarding which Rabbi Yehuda and Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel disagree. And as for [the fact] that it cites the statement of Rav Yehuda — [that is] because [the baraita] was not known to them. You should know [that this is so], for later [39a] it says regarding the statement of Rav Yehuda: "Shmuel said: And with that [same] bread"; and how could Shmuel explain the statement of Rav Yehuda, who was his student? Rather, certainly Rav Yehuda was reciting a baraita.

Tosafot on Eruvin 38b:20:1.hebrew: כמאן כרבי יוחנן בן נורי - וא"ת: והא ר' יוחנן בן נורי לא אמר אלא בישן חוץ לתחום, אבל תוך התחום הרי הוא כרגלי אנשי אותה העיר? וי"ל: דהתם משום דסתמא דעתו להיות כאנשי אותה העיר:
Tosafot on Eruvin 38b:20:1.english: In accordance with whose [opinion]? In accordance with Rabbi Yoḥanan ben Nuri - And if you say: But didn't Rabbi Yoḥanan ben Nuri say [this] only regarding one who was sleeping outside the [city's Shabbat] boundary, whereas within the boundary, he is like the feet of the people of that city? And one can say: There, [it is] because ordinarily his intention is to be like the people of that city.
